Hi Liam / Priya \u0014

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: run Redwood Private in ACME\u0019s VPC for regulatory workloads (PII-heavy inference).
- Key constraints: restricted egress, customer KMS, audit logging for token-level access, and high availability across two AZs.
- Traffic profile: ~200 reqs/min bursty, avg 256 tokens per response, expected growth 3x in 12 months.

As we discussed, the best next step is to set up a technical architecture review / demo with our Solutions team to walk through:
1) Private deployment topology (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink)
2) KMS/HSM integration options and key rotation
3) Network flows and egress controls
4) HA & scaling patterns and estimated cost profiles

Marissa (solutions) and Nikhil (security) are looped here and will lead the deep dive. Can you share 2\u00133 60\u001390min windows next week that work for you? Happy to send a calendar invite.

Agenda draft attached. Let us know if you want any specific folks (network/security/infra) on the ACME side to join.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
